name: r3f-blob
title: 3D Shader Blob
blurb: Morphs fluidly with Perlin noise, responds to hover and cursor position.
description: 3D icosahedron rendered with Three.js shaders and Perlin noise displacement. Increases distortion on hover and follows mouse cursor position in real time.
use_when: A dramatic full-screen hero section or background that conveys technical sophistication.
avoid_when: Mobile surfaces or touch-only devices — no pointer to track. Requires a GPU-capable browser.
a11y: No keyboard navigation or focus handling. Pointer events only; inaccessible to keyboard users.
